text:
```yaml
name: Moq FFI Hops-Based Broadcast Routing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: cargo build --release

    - name: Run tests
      run: cargo test --release

    - name: Check code formatting
      run: cargo fmt -- --check

    - name: Run just check
      run: ./scripts/just-check.sh
```
